fixture.description: ListWeave is a small in-memory library for arranging JSON list data. This snapshot contains unique(values). A duplicate-filtering refactor now misses repeats separated by other entries. Restore the documented contract. values is either a JSON list or None; other argument types are outside this task contract. requirements.text: For a list values, unique returns the first member of each Python == equality class, in original first-occurrence order. Equality is recursive for lists and dictionaries; strings compare exactly without Unicode normalization, and Python numeric equality includes True == 1 and False == 0. Nested JSON values and None elements are supported. The empty list returns [].
For list input, unique leaves the caller list and all its nested lists and dictionaries unchanged, including when removing nonadjacent duplicates.
Passing None as values raises TypeError.
